task.title: Issue #94 content gap: draft 9 text-only Niche Blueprint posts (drafts only, nothing published)
task.objective: Issue #94 reports the editorial queue needs content. Write a file named drafts.md containing exactly 9 numbered social post drafts for The Anonymous Marketer (Threads, Instagram, Facebook) promoting the Niche Blueprint. Rules: text only, no media references, no hashtags beyond 2 per post, under 400 characters each, each post leads with a Blueprint-first hook, no prices, no links, no invented results or testimonials, no mention of HumanVibe. After each post add one line 'Channel fit:' naming which of the three channels it suits best. Do not publish or call any external service.
